 "architecture": "Three layers. (1) Own Python bot \"Coverdrive\" (best 2.52, now retired): five persistent modes (acquire, engage, escape, recover, relocate); goal re-chosen every 0.5 s or immediately on low HP / leaving the zone; recovery latch on below 58% HP, off at 92%; additive utility score for loot; movement chosen by rolling out about 37 candidates (16 headings at walk and at boost, straight-to-waypoint, a slowed-arrival version, previous move, idle) for 0.8 s in 0.1 s steps with an acceleration model, scored on waypoint progress, zone overshoot, swept projectile clearance, enemy proximity, and LOS-blocking when fleeing. Per-tick wall-clock sub-budgets: goal 6 ms, route 10 ms, movement 18 ms, target LOS 22 ms. (2) Active scored entry: LanceHuang245's single-file controller, byte-identical, behind a ~30-line adapter that only sets a strategy flag before import and (in the 4.79 version) resets one timer. That controller is a per-tick priority chain: zone-urgent, then cover (retreating / too many threats / outranged, unless a close fight or finishing chance), then zone must-go, then cube, then \"arm up\" loot, then fight, then loot, then roam. Aim/fire is computed independently of the movement mode. (3) HEAD ships the same thing as three Cython-compiled binaries (the vendored bot binary is identical across r2/r3/r4; only the wrapper grows). Identifier names left in the wrapper's string table suggest: r2 = quiet + rapid-strafe flags + charge guard; r3 (HEAD) = adds a conditional \"preserve gun\" pickup rule keyed on a rival's distance vs lightning range and on retreat state; r4 = adds a damage-history filter (damagers, farmed NPC ids, rear hits, LOS, zone state). These three are inferred from names only, not read as source.",
 "navigation": "Own bot: A* on a 5 m ground lattice with body-cylinder clearance (holes, bridges, step-up, slope), capped at 2000 node expansions per call, resumable across ticks and deadline-bounded, then string-pull smoothing; re-routed every 1 s or on mode change; waypoints popped within max(3 m, body radius). Stuck = moved under 0.08 m in a tick while commanding motion for 1.5 s, then jump + boost if energy above 50 and drop the path. No roof or jet routing. Active (Lance) controller: 2 m raster of building tops/bases plus nearest-sample terrain; time-sliced A* that stops at about 26 ms into the tick and resumes next tick; skipped when the goal is within 8 m or the straight line is clear; path follower looks ahead up to 32 m for the farthest directly reachable node and replans if more than 28 m off route; no planning when more than 3 m above ground (local steering only). Local steering picks the best of 16 headings, penalising blocked probes at 3, 6 and 10 m, with a small bonus for keeping the previous heading. Stuck: commanding more than 0.3 while horizontal speed is under 2.5 m/s accumulates a timer (about 0.6 s); if the obstacle ahead is under 40 m taller and energy is above 35 it \"climbs\" for 2.5 s (jump, then jet toward goal), otherwise it takes a random 90 to 150 degree detour for 1.5 s. A second watchdog every 2.5 s: goal more than 20 m away but moved under 5 m forces a replan, twice in a row forces a climb. Roof loot: when within 14 m of a pickup that is more than 1.5 m above, it starts a short climb. Boosts to loot/cubes farther than 30 m when no real threat is within 80 m (starts above 60 energy, continues down to 22).",
 "aiming_and_fire_control": "Own bot: closed-form constant-velocity intercept for the gun (numerically stable root choice); a shot is authorised only if the ACTUAL torso direction lies within a cone of 0.75 body radii at that range and the actual ray is unobstructed. Laser: starts charging only if the time needed to turn onto the target is no more than the charge time; holds until full and aligned, then releases. Lightning: fires only if the intended target is the nearest eligible body in the cone, so the auto-target cannot pick something else. Mortar: low arc first, then high, with 7 fixed-point iterations for target motion and barrel offset, arc sampled every 0.08 s for collisions, refused if the impact is within splash + radii of our current or predicted position. Shared-torso aim priority: charging laser, ready laser, gun, lightning, mortar. Reload when empty, or when no target and the magazine is not full. All firing suppressed while recovering. Active (Lance) controller: two-pass gun lead with an extra 0.05 s latency allowance and vertical lead clamped to 6 m; fires the gun whenever within range minus 3 m and yaw error under atan(1.6 x target radius / distance) + 0.012 rad (pitch: atan(3 m / distance) + 0.004). Laser: begins charging on any mech or drone inside range minus 5 m (crates only if no gun); keeps aiming the gun solution while charging and switches to the laser solution (0.1 s lead) only at full charge; releases when full and aligned, or just before the 2 s forced auto-fire. Lightning: fires inside range minus 1 m when the target is within 40% of the cone half-angle and energy covers the cost + 1. Target score = distance + 0.2 x HP, minus 100 if under 30% HP, minus 120 for the current target (stickiness), minus 40 if it hit us in the last 4 s, plus 400 if not shootable. Reloads when idle and the magazine is under 60%. Never takes a mortar (laser cook-off risk) and drops one if held. The GT Goats variant they tested adds magazine-aware finishing: estimate burst damage from live magazine, cooldown and reload state and prefer a wounded target that the remaining magazine can kill.",
 "survival_and_anti_squad_tactics": "Nothing is squad-specific; it is generic free-for-all survival. Active (Lance) controller: retreat latch on below 38% HP with threats visible, off above 80% HP or after 12 s without damage and above 60%. Also goes to cover when \"too many\" (3+ visible threats, or 2+ with HP under 60%, or incoming damage above 110/s over a 2.5 s window, or damage from an unseen attacker) or \"outranged\" (a laser holder beyond 70 m while we hold no laser). Cover search: 16 directions x 7 distances (7 to 75 m) reachable in a straight walk; score = 100 per threat eye (nearest 3) that can still see the point + 0.8 x distance, biased away from the threats, heavy penalties outside the current/next circle; a zero-visibility spot is cached for up to 4 s and re-verified every third tick; boosts to cover if hit in the last 2 s. With no cover: go arm up if unarmed with loot within 90 m, else stand and trade; if outranged, healthy (above 50%) and facing one threat, charge in to 22 m. Close-fight override (do not retreat): target within 40 m and we hold lightning or HP above 50%, or a finishing chance (target at or under 30% HP, within 130 m, own HP above 30%, at most 2 threats). Unseen attacker: a pseudo-threat is placed 120 m along the damage bearing and the torso turns to look. Dodging: sidestep perpendicular to a charging laser whose aim line passes within 7 m + 3% of range (skipped if we can zap it within 40 m, since lightning shorts lasers); sidestep bullets whose closest approach is within 3.8 m in the next 0.45 s; run from predicted mortar landings within 13 m and 3.5 s (boost if under 1.2 s and 9 m). Fight spacing: 110 m with laser, 28 m with lightning, 85 m gun-only; strafe at 0.85 lateral, flipping every 1 to 2.6 s (0.35 to 0.9 s with the rapid-strafe flag). Quiet walking caps speed at 4.6 m/s (below the 5 m/s footstep threshold) when roaming/cube/cover, enemies are tracked or a sound was heard in the last 8 s, and no damage in 3 s. An optional \"patient\" flag (off) only opens fire on cheap fights (within 55 m, 4 or fewer alive, target under 55% HP, it shot us in the last 6 s, it is charging, or its aim is more than 75 degrees off us). Own bot: recovery suppresses all own fire so the 5 s regen timer can run; cover sampled on 18 m and 38 m rings, +55 per enemy muzzle blocked when recovering; escapes when 2+ enemies and the nearest is within 85 m.",
 "loot_weapons_upgrades": "Active (Lance) controller: target loadout laser + lightning, gun as fallback. Chases a wanted weapon up to 240 m when holding neither (160 m otherwise), ignoring items more than 25 m above/below or outside the safe circle unless within 30 m. On arrival fills an empty slot, else drops the gun (never mid-charge), else the mortar. Cubes: collect within 70 m (120 m when roaming) if safe and at most one real threat. Crates: shoot any within 150 m with a clear shot, stand at 22 m; remembered crates up to 260 m away when HP above 60% and no threats. NPC drones: only when HP above 55%, within 140 m, stand at 50 m. Supply drops: go when calm, HP above 45%, within 170 m and reachable by landing + 8 s; skip if someone else already has more than 1.5 s of capture progress. Upgrade order: plating, armor, nanites, laser damage, lightning efficiency, gun rate, laser charge, gun damage, capacitor, reactor, gyros, lightning range, gun mag, sensors, gun velocity, servos, jets, then mortar items last.  "zone_and_endgame": "Active (Lance) controller: tracks the interpolated shrinking circle. Safety margin = min(30 m, 30% of next radius). \"Must go\" when walking time for the missing distance (at a hard-coded 11.7 m/s) + 12 s exceeds the time left; \"urgent\" when outside the zone or within 8 m of the current edge. Urgent zone movement outranks everything, including cover; goal is the next centre (detours to a wanted pickup within 25 m); boosts when urgent with energy above 25, or when more than 60 m short with energy above 60. Dodge strength is halved while urgent. Other goals are clamped to the next circle when must-go; roaming drifts until within 55% of the next radius. No dedicated endgame or final-circle logic.  "novel_ideas": [
  "Swept-segment projectile avoidance: test the bullet's motion relative to our own motion over each 0.1 s step, clipped to body height, instead of sampling endpoints (a bullet travels about 25 m per decision).",
  "Add a slowed-arrival candidate to any rollout-based mover, and aim for a body-clear point on the pickup ring rather than the item centre.",
  "Any speed-based stuck detector must scale its threshold by the charge slowdown and by any deliberate speed cap, or it fires false jumps.",
  "Fire lightning only when the intended target is the nearest eligible body in the cone, since the weapon auto-targets.",
  "Start a laser charge only if the torso can turn onto the target within the charge time.",
  "Lightning shorts lasers: within 40 m of a charging laser, zap instead of dodging.",
  "Suppress own fire while recovering so the 5 s no-damage regen timer can start (a laser already charging cannot be cancelled and will fire once).",
  "Place a pseudo-threat 120 m along the damage bearing for unseen attackers, so cover search and facing react to snipers.",
  "Magazine-aware finishing: prefer the target the remaining magazine can actually kill (+0.39 official).",
  "Pre-arm rule: with gun only, go for a laser/lightning pickup before accepting a fight unless the enemy is within 50 m.",
  "Process: one-knob official A/B per submission slot, an immutable score ledger, and a moving target of leader + 0.25.",
  "From wrapper identifier names only: a later build appears to filter the damage history (farmed drones, rear hits, zone state) before the retreat logic sees it, and to keep the gun unless a rival is inside lightning range."

 "apparent_weaknesses": [
  "The competitive entry is other teams' code (GT Goats, then LanceHuang245) behind a tiny wrapper, and HEAD hides it in compiled binaries; original contribution is thin and exposed to the no-code-sharing rule. Their own bot peaked at 2.52.",
  "No logic aimed at the practice squad: no model of escalation, no count of dead house bots, no special handling of the single early hunter or the late all-in.",
  "Regen is undermined: the active controller keeps firing at any shootable enemy and at crates while retreating, which resets the 5 s no-damage timer.",
  "Opens gun fire out to about 227 m and laser to 275 m on anything shootable, which reveals position and wastes magazines at long range; the selective-engagement flag is off.",
  "Laser aim follows the gun-lead solution during charge and only switches at full charge; with a 1.6 x radius yaw tolerance this likely misses moving targets at 100 m+.",
  "Stuck handling is fragile: the 2.5 m/s threshold caused false jumps (documented), and recovery is a blind 2.5 s jump-and-jet or a random detour.",
  "Geometry is coarse: 2 m raster, nearest-sample terrain, LOS ray-marched in 2.5 m steps (4 m for cover checks), no trees or canopy, so thin walls and corners can be misjudged; A* is ground-only.",
  "Cover search only considers points reachable in a straight walk within 75 m and the nearest 3 threats; with no cover it stands and trades.",
